utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Madam Registrar, will you please call the case.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. This is case number IT-98-33/1-I, the Prosecutor against Vidoje Blagojevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: May I have the appearances, please, for the Prosecution.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Microphone, please. Microphone, please.

utterances.speaker: MS. DEL PONTE
utterances.text: Carla Del Ponte, with Mr. Mark Vlasic, co-counsel. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. For the accused.

utterances.speaker: MR. VAN DER SPOEL
utterances.text: Good morning, Your Honour. My name is ^ Van Der Spoel. I'm a Dutch attorney and provisional Defence counsel for Mr. Blagojevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Blagojevic, can you hear the proceedings in a language that you can understand?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: (Interpretation) Yes. I'm able to follow in my language, yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Could you state your full name, please.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: (Interpretation) I am Vidoje Blagojevic.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Could you state the date, sir, upon which you believe you were born?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: (Interpretation) I was born on the 22nd of June, 1950.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. You may sit down, please.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: (Interpretation) Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: We are here this morning for the initial appearance of the accused in accordance with Rule 62 of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence upon his transfer to the Tribunal. I'm here acting in my capacity as Duty Judge pursuant to Rule 28. I should inform you that this case has been assigned, by order of the President of 13 August 2001 to Trial Chamber III. Mr. Van Der Spoel.

utterances.speaker: MR. VAN DER SPOEL
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Has your client received a copy of the indictment in a language which he understands?

utterances.speaker: MR. VAN DER SPOEL
utterances.text: Yes, he has, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Have you had a chance to go through it with him yet?

utterances.speaker: MR. VAN DER SPOEL
utterances.text: I have discussed very briefly the indictment with my client, and he understands it quite well.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: I'm so glad to hear that. Does he understand the contents of the indictment or is he aware of the nature of the allegations made against him?

utterances.speaker: MR. VAN DER SPOEL
utterances.text: My conference with him was too brief to discuss everything in detail as he sees me as his provisional Defence counsel at the moment. He was aware of his rights and it was, for him, sufficient.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: If you have discussed the contents of the indictment with your client, may I know whether he wishes the indictment to be read out in full, which is his right, or he wishes to waive his right?

utterances.speaker: MR. VAN DER SPOEL
utterances.text: He does not wish to have it read. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. I'm very grateful to hear that. Does your client know that he must plead to the charge in the indictment within 30 days of the initial appearance, and if he so wishes, he can also do so today. Is he ready to enter a plea today?

utterances.speaker: MR. VAN DER SPOEL
utterances.text: He is, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. Mr. Blagojevic, will you please stand up. Mr. Blagojevic, are you ready to enter pleas to the charges against you in the indictment?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: (Interpretation) I am ready.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: I propose to read out to you just the charge and then I'll ask you how do you plead to the charge, guilt or not guilty. Your answer in each case should be guilty or not guilty, as the case may be. The first count against you is a charge of genocide. How do you plead, guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: (Interpretation) Your Honour, I am familiar with the indictment. I have read it and understood it, and on the basis of the same, I plead not guilty on this count too.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The second count is a charge of complicity to commit genocide. How do you plead, guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: (Interpretation) Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The third count is a charge of extermination, being a crime against humanity. How do you plead, guilty or not guilty? Blank page inserted to ensure pagination corresponds between the French and the English transcripts.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: (Interpretation) Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The fourth count is a charge of murder as a crime against humanity. Do you plead guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: (Interpretation) Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The fifth count is another charge of murder as a violation of the laws or customs of war. How do you plead, guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: (Interpretation) Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The sixth count is a charge of persecution on political, racial, and religious grounds, being a crime against humanity. How do you plead, guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: (Interpretation) Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The seventh count is a charge of deportation, being a crime against humanity. How do you plead, guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: (Interpretation) Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The eighth count is a charge of inhumane act, forcible transfer as a crime against humanity. Do you plead guilty or not guilty?

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: (Interpretation) Not guilty.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Please sit down, sir.

utterances.speaker: THE ACCUSED
utterances.text: (Interpretation) Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: The registrar will be instructed to fix a date for trial when appropriate, and the accused is remanded in custody until further order. I would like to remind the Prosecutor of your obligation under Rule 66(A)(i) of the Rules of Procedure and Evidence with regard to the disclosure of the supporting materials within 30 days of today. I would also remind the counsel for the accused, whether you will continue to serve as his counsel after today or not, that preliminary motions pursuant to Rule 72 may be filed on behalf of the accused no later than 30 days after the disclosure by the Prosecutor pursuant to the Rule 66(A)(i). Is there any matter which the Prosecution wishes to raise at this moment? Madam Del Ponte?

utterances.speaker: MS. DEL PONTE
utterances.text: Yes, Your Honour, just to inform that we are ready for the disclosure of the material, but we wait if the Defence counsel is the definitive Defence counsel. But if he wishes, we can hand over now the supporting material. And the second information is that we will present a joint motion to have just one trial for the accused Blagojevic, Obrenovic, and Jokic, all three together. It will be a written motion. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Well, I'm just a Duty Judge performing my duty in the absence of other Judges at the moment, but your argument really has a very strong point. I will certainly bring your point to the attention of the President of this Tribunal when he comes back. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MS. DEL PONTE
utterances.text: Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Mr. Van Der Spoel, do you want to raise any matters at this stage?

utterances.speaker: MR. VAN DER SPOEL
utterances.text: Not at the moment. Thank you, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Now, one thing I would like to remind you is that before you leave this case, you better talk to your client and ask him to hire an attorney for him. So far as I know, the procedures of this are very complicated. To hire a lawyer to his benefit will be greatly assisting him to know what is going on before this Tribunal.

utterances.speaker: MR. VAN DER SPOEL
utterances.text: I agree with you, Your Honour, but my client has instructed me only to act as his Defence counsel at this hearing. He will think about his definite choice. At the moment, I can't do anything more.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE LIU
utterances.text: Thank you. I will take note of that. So that's all. We are adjourned.
